batches.create.limits.source: Limits on this gateway: up to {file} per file, {line} per line, {requests} requests, {uploads} uploads per hour. Storage {used} of {storage} · unfinished batches {active} of {maxActive}.
batches.create.limits.text: 本网关限额：每个文件最大 {file}，每行最大 {line}，最多 {requests} 条请求，每小时最多上传 {uploads} 次。文件空间已用 {used} / {storage} · 未结束任务 {active} / {maxActive}。

batches.create.model_file_unusable.source: Use the file's model (not possible: the file names several models, none, or one you cannot use)
batches.create.model_file_unusable.text: 使用文件中的模型（不可用：文件中有多个模型、没有模型，或使用了你无权使用的模型）

batches.create.model_override.source: Use one model for every request:

batches.create.no_models.source: No model of this type is available to you.
batches.create.no_models.text: 你当前没有可用的这类模型。

batches.create.other_params.source: Other parameters in the file, kept as they are:
batches.create.other_params.text: 文件中的其他参数（原样保留）：

batches.create.params_not_taken.source: This model does not take {params}, so it cannot be set for every request.
batches.create.params_not_taken.text: 该模型不接受 {params}，因此不能为所有请求统一设置。

batches.create.pending.confirming.source: Confirming the result of your submission. It is sent again with the same key, so it cannot create a second batch.
batches.create.pending.confirming.text: 正在确认提交结果。系统会用同一个键重新发送，不会因此多建一个任务。

batches.create.pending.sending.source: Submitting… The file is checked once more before the batch is created.
batches.create.pending.sending.text: 正在提交… 创建任务前会再检查一遍文件。

batches.create.preview_hint.source: This is what the batch stores. The gateway may still adapt a request for its provider when it runs (for example its format); that is not shown.
batches.create.preview_hint.text: 这里展示的是任务存储的请求。执行时网关仍可能为上游供应商做协议转换（例如格式），这部分不在预览中。

batches.create.refused.credential_change.source: Your API key changed after you confirmed (it was regenerated, revoked or replaced). Check the submission again.
batches.create.refused.credential_change.text: 确认之后你的 API 密钥发生了变化（被重新生成、撤销或替换）。请重新校验并确认。

batches.create.refused.model_changed.source: The chosen model now resolves to a different model than the one you confirmed. Check the submission again.
batches.create.refused.model_changed.text: 所选模型现在解析到的模型与你确认时不同。请重新校验并确认。

batches.create.refused.no_key.source: A batch runs under your active API key, and you have none. Create one on the dashboard, then submit again.
batches.create.refused.no_key.text: 批处理任务以你当前有效的 API 密钥运行，而你还没有密钥。请先在仪表盘创建，然后再提交。

batches.create.refused.quota.source: Your daily quota is spent. Submit after it renews (00:00 UTC) or once it is raised; uploading and checking stay free.
batches.create.refused.quota.text: 你今天的额度已用完。请在额度重置（UTC 0 点）或调整后再提交；上传和校验仍然免费。

batches.create.refused.source.source: The source file was deleted or expired. Upload it again; your settings are kept.
batches.create.refused.source.text: 源文件已被删除或已过期。请重新上传；你的设置会保留。

batches.create.same_as_original.source: Same content as the original file.

batches.create.stale.choice.source: Check your batch list first. Submitting again makes a new, separate submission, which can create and bill a second batch.
batches.create.stale.choice.text: 请先查看任务列表。再次提交会产生一次新的、独立的提交，可能会创建并计费第二个任务。

batches.create.stale.confirm.source: Submit the same content again as a new batch? If the earlier submission did create a batch that has since ended and been removed, this creates (and bills) another one.
batches.create.stale.confirm.text: 将相同内容作为新任务再次提交？如果之前那次提交确实创建过任务，而该任务已经结束并被清除，这次会再创建（并计费）一个任务。

batches.create.stale.new.source: Submit again as a new batch

batches.create.stale.text.source: A submission from {when} ("{name}") never got an answer, and it is too old to send again safely: the gateway no longer guarantees to recognise it. No batch from it can be found now; one may have been created, finished and removed since.
batches.create.stale.text.text: {when} 的一次提交（“{name}”）一直没有得到结果，而且已经太久，不能再安全地重发：网关不再保证能识别它。现在找不到它创建的任务；它可能创建过任务，并且该任务已经结束并被清除。

batches.create.subtitle.source: Text generation or embeddings from a JSONL file: upload it, confirm the model and settings, then check and submit.
batches.create.subtitle.text: 从 JSONL 文件创建文本生成或文本向量化任务：上传文件，确认模型和设置，然后校验并提交。

batches.create.summary.billing_text.source: Each request is billed like the same live request; there is no batch discount and no estimate. It counts toward your daily quota, and the batch pauses when the quota is spent.
batches.create.summary.billing_text.text: 每条请求按相同的实时请求计费，没有批量折扣，也不提供预估。费用计入每日额度，额度用尽时任务暂停。

batches.create.summary.copy.source: The batch stores its own copy of the requests as shown below; the copy counts toward your storage and is deleted with the batch or the source file.
batches.create.summary.copy.text: 任务会按下方所示存储自己的一份请求副本；副本计入你的存储空间，并随任务或源文件一起删除。

batches.create.summary.key_text.source: Signing out or closing the browser does not stop the batch. Revoking or regenerating this key fails its unfinished requests.
batches.create.summary.key_text.text: 退出登录或关闭浏览器不会停止任务。撤销或重新生成这把密钥会使未结束的请求失败。

batches.create.summary.model_alias.source: {requested}, which is {canonical}: the batch runs on {canonical}

batches.create.summary.no_key.text: 没有有效的 API 密钥

batches.create.summary.no_overrides.text: 沿用文件中的值，不做修改

batches.create.summary.retention_text.source: Results are kept {days} days after the batch ends. The source file is kept until {date}.
batches.create.summary.retention_text.text: 结果在任务结束后保留 {days} 天。源文件保留到 {date}。

batches.create.summary.type_choice.source: Type chosen by you; url filled in on every line.
batches.create.summary.type_choice.text: 类型由你选择；已为每一行补上 url。

batches.create.summary.type_structure.source: Type recognized from the request bodies; url filled in on every line.
batches.create.summary.type_structure.text: 类型根据请求体识别；已为每一行补上 url。

batches.create.summary.window_text.source: Every request starts within {hours} hours; requests already started may finish after that. Requests not started by then expire.
batches.create.summary.window_text.text: 所有请求在 {hours} 小时内开始执行；已开始的请求可以在此之后完成。届时仍未开始的请求将过期。

batches.create.too_large.source: The file is larger than this gateway accepts.
batches.create.too_large.text: 文件超过了本网关允许的大小。

batches.create.unsupported.source: This browser cannot coordinate a submission across tabs safely (it has neither Web Locks nor IndexedDB), so it cannot submit from here. Use another browser, or /v1/batches.
batches.create.unsupported.text: 这个浏览器无法在多个标签页之间安全地协调提交（既不支持 Web Locks，也不支持 IndexedDB），因此不能在这里提交。请换一个浏览器，或使用 /v1/batches。

batches.create.valid.source: {count} requests are valid. Checking is free and does not guarantee that every request will succeed.
batches.create.valid.text: {count} 条请求格式有效。校验不收费，也不保证每条请求都能执行成功。

batches.detail.cancel_semantics.source: Cancelling stops requests that have not started; requests already running finish and are billed. Results so far stay available to download.
batches.detail.cancel_semantics.text: 取消后，尚未开始的请求不再执行；正在执行的请求会完成并计费。已有结果仍可下载。

batches.detail.copy_inline.source: This batch was submitted as direct requests, so there is no input file to reuse. Copying it is not available yet.
batches.detail.copy_inline.text: 这个任务以直接提交的请求创建，没有可复用的输入文件。暂不支持复制。

batches.detail.copy_reupload.source: Its source file is no longer stored. Copying keeps the settings and asks you to upload the file again.
batches.detail.copy_reupload.text: 它的源文件已不再保留。复制会保留设置，并要求你重新上传文件。

batches.detail.copy_target.source: Batches of this type cannot be created in the console yet; submit them through /v1/batches. You can still manage this one and download its results.
batches.detail.copy_target.text: 这类任务暂不支持在控制台创建；请通过 /v1/batches 提交。你仍可以管理这个任务并下载结果。

batches.detail.credential.text: 运行所用 API 密钥

batches.detail.model_override.source: Set for every request in the console

batches.detail.results_pending.source: Results can be downloaded once the batch has finished.
batches.detail.results_pending.text: 任务结束后即可下载结果。

batches.detail.unfinished_hint.source: Unfinished requests are the failed, expired and cancelled ones, as they were stored: fix them and upload the file as a new batch. Nothing runs until you submit it. The error file explains failures and cannot be submitted again as is.
batches.detail.unfinished_hint.text: 未成功请求包括失败、过期未执行和已取消的请求，内容与存储时一致：修改后可作为新任务重新上传。提交之前不会执行任何请求。错误结果文件用于说明失败原因，不能直接重新提交。

batches.detail.unknown_cost.source: {count} attempt(s) of unknown cost, not included (the request was sent but its result was lost)
batches.detail.unknown_cost.text: 另有 {count} 次尝试费用未知，未计入（请求已发出但结果丢失）

batches.empty_create.source: You have no batches. Create one here, or submit one through the API.
batches.empty_create.text: 你还没有批次。可以在这里创建，或通过 API 提交。

batches.empty_filtered.text: 没有符合搜索条件的批次。

batches.files.confirm_delete.source: Delete this file? Batches already submitted from it keep running, but it can no longer be used or copied from.
batches.files.confirm_delete.text: 删除这个文件？已经用它提交的任务会继续运行，但它不能再用于新任务或复制。

batches.files.meta.text: {size} · {lines} 行 · 上传于 {created} · 保留到 {expires}

batches.files.usage.source: {used} of {limit} used (stored copies of submitted batches included). Files are deleted automatically when they expire.
batches.files.usage.text: 已用 {used} / {limit}（包括已提交任务的请求副本）。文件到期后会自动删除。

batches.filter.unavailable.source: Filtering by status is not available right now while the service is being updated. Try again in a moment, or show all batches.
batches.filter.unavailable.text: 服务更新期间暂时无法按状态筛选。请稍后重试，或查看全部批次。

batches.note.cancelling.source: Cancelling: requests already running will finish
batches.note.cancelling.text: 正在取消，进行中的请求会完成

batches.notice.cannot_submit.source: Your plan cannot submit new batches: that needs the {role} plan or higher. Your existing batches stay manageable here: download their results, cancel or delete them, and view or remove your webhook.
batches.notice.cannot_submit.text: 你的套餐不能提交新批次：需要{role}或更高的套餐。已有的批次仍可在这里管理：下载结果、取消或删除，以及查看或移除你的 Webhook。

batches.notice.capabilities_error.source: Could not check what Batch offers your account ({error}). Your batches are listed below.
batches.notice.capabilities_error.text: 无法确认你的账号可用的批量功能（{error}）。你的批次列在下方。

batches.paused.quota.source: Paused: your daily quota is spent. It resumes after {until} (when the quota renews at 00:00 UTC) or once your quota is raised.
batches.paused.quota.text: 已暂停：今日额度已用完。将在 {until} 之后（额度于 UTC 0 点重置时）或额度调整后恢复。

batches.paused.role.source: Paused: your plan no longer includes Batch. It is checked again after {until}; you can still cancel it or download what finished.
batches.paused.role.text: 已暂停：你的套餐不再包含批处理。将在 {until} 之后重新检查；你仍可以取消任务或下载已完成的结果。

batches.row.unknown_cost_visible.text: 有 {count} 次尝试的费用未知

batches.search.label.source: Search by name or batch ID
batches.search.label.text: 按名称或任务 ID 搜索

batches.search.placeholder.source: Search by name or batch ID
batches.search.placeholder.text: 按名称或任务 ID 搜索

batches.subtitle_create.text: 查看并管理批处理任务与结果。

batches.unavailable.disabled.source: Batch inference is turned off on this gateway. Batches you submitted before are kept and show here again when it is turned back on.
batches.unavailable.disabled.text: 此网关已关闭批量推理。之前提交的批次会保留，重新开启后会再次显示在这里。

batches.unavailable.not_ready.source: Batch inference is temporarily unavailable on this gateway. Try again in a moment.
batches.unavailable.not_ready.text: 此网关的批量推理暂时不可用，请稍后再试。

batches.webhook.cannot_create.source: Your plan cannot set up a webhook.
batches.webhook.cannot_create.text: 你的套餐不能设置 Webhook。

batches.webhook.confirm_delete.source: Remove the webhook? Undelivered events are dropped.
batches.webhook.confirm_delete.text: 移除 Webhook？未送达的事件将被丢弃。

batches.webhook.confirm_rotate.source: Rotate the signing secret? Deliveries are signed with the new secret from now on.
batches.webhook.confirm_rotate.text: 轮换签名密钥？之后的投递都用新密钥签名。

batches.webhook.read_only.source: Your plan cannot change webhook settings. You can still view and remove your webhook.
batches.webhook.read_only.text: 你的套餐不能修改 Webhook 设置，但仍可以查看和移除已有的 Webhook。

batches.webhook.secret_once.source: Signing secret — save it now, it is not shown again. Verify the webhook-signature header with it.
batches.webhook.secret_once.text: 签名密钥——请现在保存，之后不再显示。用它验证 webhook-signature 请求头。

batches.webhook.secret_reminder.source: Save the signing secret now; it is shown only once.
batches.webhook.secret_reminder.text: 请立即保存签名密钥，仅显示一次。

batches.webhook.subtitle.source: Get a signed POST when one of your batches ends and its results can be fetched. Events name the batch only; fetch the results with your API key.
batches.webhook.subtitle.text: 你的批次结束、结果可以获取时，会收到一个签名的 POST。事件只写明批次，结果请用你的 API Key 获取。

chrome.account_changed.switched_title.text: 你在另一个标签页切换了账户

dashboard.models.subtitle.text: 调用 API 时要用到的模型 ID 和 token 上限。

landing.features.free_body.text: 无需信用卡，额度充足，做研究、搭原型都够用。

stats.languages.intro.source: We detected {count} languages in the messages people send. English comes first, but {non_english} of the {classified} accounts we could classify also wrote in another language. The count comes from a sample of {sampled} messages, so it is a lower bound.
stats.languages.intro.text: 我们在用户发送的消息里识别出 {count} 种语言。英语排第一，但在 {classified} 个能识别语言的账户中，有 {non_english} 个也用过其他语言。这个数字来自 {sampled} 条消息的抽样，所以只是下限。

stats.meta_description.source: Tokens served, countries, languages and agents on {app_name}, refreshed daily.
stats.meta_description.text: {app_name} 处理的 token、请求来源国家、写作语言和调用 Agent，每天更新。

stats.method.accounts_body.source: Approved users are accounts that have been let in; the waiting list is sign-ups still waiting for review. Both are counted when the snapshot is made.
stats.method.accounts_body.text: “已通过的用户”是已经放行的账户；“等待审核”是还在排队审核的注册申请。两者都按生成快照那一刻的数字计算。

stats.method.agents_body.source: A client is the product name at the start of the User-Agent header, ignoring version and platform; generic HTTP libraries, SDKs and browsers are not counted. A client or product needs {min_requests} successful requests to count. Account counts below {min_accounts} are shown as “{withheld}”.
stats.method.agents_body.text: 客户端指 User-Agent 头开头的产品名，忽略版本和平台；通用的 HTTP 库、SDK 和浏览器不计入。一个客户端或产品至少要有 {min_requests} 次成功请求才会被统计。账户数少于 {min_accounts} 时显示为“{withheld}”。

stats.method.countries_body.source: Each request's IP address is geolocated when it is logged; only the country is kept. Addresses that cannot be placed are left out.
stats.method.countries_body.text: 每个请求在记录日志时会根据 IP 地址定位，只保留国家或地区。无法定位的地址不计入。

stats.method.languages_body.source: Each week we sample up to 8 distinct messages per account, strip code and markup, and identify the language of each sentence with fastText's lid.176 model. A language counts for an account when at least two sampled messages are mainly in it. Romanized writing, such as Hindi in Latin script, cannot be detected.
stats.method.languages_body.text: 每周从每个账户最多抽取 8 条不同的消息，去掉代码和标记后，用 fastText 的 lid.176 模型逐句识别语言。一个账户至少有两条抽样消息主要使用某种语言，才算这个账户用了这种语言。用拉丁字母书写的语言（比如用拉丁字母写的印地语）无法识别。

stats.method.models_body.source: Each request counts under the model it named, so an alias counts as its model and an auto model as itself, not the model chosen to serve it. Models not offered to the public, and models since retired, are counted together as “{other}”.
stats.method.models_body.text: 每个请求都记在它指定的模型名下：别名记在对应的模型上，自动模型记在它自己名下，而不是实际处理请求的那个模型。没有对外开放的模型和已经下线的模型，统一算作“{other}”。

stats.method.title.text: 这些数字是怎么统计的

stats.method.tokens_body.source: Successful requests only, excluding our own health checks. Input counts the whole prompt, including cached prefixes. Weeks start on Monday (UTC).
stats.method.tokens_body.text: 只统计成功的请求，不包括我们自己的健康检查。输入 token 按完整的提示词计算，缓存命中的前缀也算在内。每周从周一开始（UTC）。

stats.models.intro.source: Requests and tokens per day for each of the {count} models we offer.

stats.models.intro_with_other.source: Requests and tokens per day for each of the {count} models we offer, with every other model counted together.
stats.models.intro_with_other.text: 我们提供的 {count} 个模型每天的请求数和 token 数，其余模型合并统计。

stats.models.tokens_per_day.text: 各模型每日 token 数

stats.models.top.text: 其中 {model} 处理了全部 token 的 {share}。

stats.partial_note.source: The first and last days are partial and drawn lighter.
stats.partial_note.text: 第一天和最后一天的数据不完整，颜色画得浅一些。

stats.subtitle.source: Who has access, how much we serve, where requests come from, which languages people write in, and which agents send them. Aggregates only, refreshed daily.
stats.subtitle.text: 谁在用、我们提供了多少服务、请求来自哪里、大家用什么语言写作、又是哪些 Agent 在发请求。只展示汇总数据，每天更新。

stats.tile.countries_note.text: 其中 {count} 个请求数达到 {min} 次以上，分布在 {continents} 个大洲

stats.tile.languages_note.text: 在 {classified} 个能识别语言的账户中，有 {count} 个还会用英语以外的语言

stats.tile.tokens_note.text: 来自 {accounts} 个账户的 {requests} 次请求

stats.tile.waiting_none.text: 目前没有待审核的注册申请

stats.tokens.intro.source: {tokens} tokens over {days} days: {input} input and {output} output. Agents resend their whole conversation on every turn, so input dominates, and at least {cached} of it was served from the prompt cache.
